title: When Superpixels Fail on Documents: A Study of Segmentation for LIME Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2609.07462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-hoc explanation methods are widely used to inspect image classifiers, but their reliability depends on design choices that are often treated as implementation details. We study this issue for LIME on document image classification, focusing on the segmentation step that defines the interpretable units being perturbed. Standard image-based LIME typically relies on natural-image superpixels, which are poorly aligned with document structure such as text regions, layout blocks, and identification codes. Using RVL-CDIP, we compare Quickshift and SLIC with document-aware segmentations based on OCR bounding boxes and regular grids. Our results show that segmentation strongly affects explanation consistency, correctness, and local fidelity. Document-aware segmentations produce more stable and faithful explanations, require fewer perturbations to converge, and expose shortcut behaviour based on document identification codes, a known RVL-CDI

translated_title: 当超像素在文档上失效时：面向LIME解释的分割方法研究
translated_abstract: 事后解释方法被广泛用于审查图像分类器，但其可靠性取决于通常被视为实现细节的设计选择。我们针对文档图像分类中的LIME方法研究这一问题，重点关注定义被扰动可解释单元的分割步骤。标准的基于图像的LIME通常依赖自然图像超像素，而这类超像素与文档结构（如文本区域、版面块和识别代码）的对齐效果较差。基于RVL-CDIP数据集，我们将Quickshift和SLIC算法与基于OCR边界框和规则网格的文档感知分割方法进行比较。结果表明，分割方式强烈影响解释的一致性、正确性和局部保真度。文档感知分割能够产生更稳定、更忠实的解释，需要更少的扰动即可收敛，并且能够揭示出基于文档识别代码的捷径行为——这是RVL-CDIP数据集中一个已知的问题。
tldr: 该研究证明LIME解释中的分割方式对文档图像分类的解释质量至关重要，基于OCR边界框和规则网格的文档感知分割比自然图像超像素产生更稳定、更忠实且收敛更快的解释，并揭示了模型利用文档识别代码的捷径行为。
en_tdlr: This study shows that the segmentation choice in LIME critically affects explanation quality for document image classification: document-aware segmentations (OCR bounding boxes and grids) yield more stable, faithful, and faster-converging explanations than natural-image superpixels, while exposing shortcut behaviour based on document identification codes.
